name: Fungispunj Sporeling
description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

abilities.name: Minion (6)
abilities.description: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

abilities.name: Group Attack
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

abilities.name: Form Up
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.
